assets.subject: simple plank door leaf
assets.detail: A single rectangular door of vertical rough wooden planks with two horizontal iron straps and a ring handle, about 3 ft wide x 7 ft tall. ONLY the door leaf itself, as if lifted off its hinges: NO door frame, NO jambs, NO lintel, NO surrounding wall, NO threshold, NO floor or ground. Standing upright, seen from the front at a slight angle; the edges of the door are the edges of the object.

assets.subject: pair of grand double door leaves
assets.detail: Two tall matching carved oak door leaves side by side and touching in the middle (a closed double door), iron studs and two ring pulls, about 6 ft wide x 9 ft tall overall. ONLY the door leaf itself, as if lifted off its hinges: NO door frame, NO jambs, NO lintel, NO surrounding wall, NO threshold, NO floor or ground. Standing upright, seen from the front at a slight angle; the edges of the door are the edges of the object.
